source_snapshot.procedure: Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists, broadly filter POWER, inspect BMC Web and retain anomalies.
source_snapshot.criteria: Both list forms and Web match SPEC; numbering is 1, 2, 78.
source_snapshot.script: No Script; Config-Check; 3/0 minutes; unique code.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES/ipmitool but invents one aggregate title sensor, truncates OOB evidence and erases the broad population.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; requires exact membership/topology and separation of power, energy, derived and discrete power-good semantics.

old_problem: POWER is a substring, not one engineering quantity: matches can represent watts, accumulated energy, voltage/current-derived values or discrete power-good states across different PSU, rail, board, CPU and device paths. The source supplies no membership/type/topology map or synchronized limits, and criteria jump from 2 to 78.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict by using complete inventories for discovery and a signed Project matrix to classify every included POWER record independently. ED-03 permits concrete paths and workload/timing bindings, ED-15 requires approved formulas and tolerances, and ED-19 prevents one aggregate value from replacing distinct members. Derived relationships are graded only when formulas, synchronized inputs and uncertainty are approved.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2034, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; next row was directly opened as Functionality 2035 / Wistron-BMC-01054-V002 / 1c5984e9721c8844.

Each included record is bound to a physical source/load/aggregation path and classified as instantaneous/average power, accumulated energy, derived electrical value or discrete state; unlike types are never compared as interchangeable.
Complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists plus all mapped Web rows prove population and interface parity under aligned workload/policy/thermal timestamps.
Energy/interval or voltage-current derivation is allowed only by approved formula, cadence, synchronization and error tolerance; otherwise the original records remain independent.
Criteria 1, 2 and 78 are retained without inventing 3-77.
No ipmitool, power query, authentication, Web capture, power/load/policy/threshold change, log clear or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Typed POWER population and physical-path reporting reconciliation
test_case.purpose: Verify every approved POWER record is correctly typed and bound to its PSU/rail/board/CPU/device path and reports SPEC-consistent value or raw/decoded state across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web under aligned operating context.
required_package: SUT/BMC/firmware and authoritative PSU/rail/board/CPU/device power topology
Signed POWER inclusion list with record IDs/types, physical source/load/aggregation path and five-view aliases
Per-record units/scaling, instantaneous/average/energy/status semantics, cadence/freshness, approved limits and any derived formula/uncertainty
Aligned workload, power policy, redundancy and thermal context, approved ipmitool and protected access
Power/platform/BMC owner and human Web/verdict responsibility
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; freeze workload/power-policy/redundancy context and preserve logs. Capture complete aligned IB/OOB `sdr elist` and `sensor list` before POWER filtering, classify every signed member by semantic type and physical path, and capture all corresponding Web rows. Compare each record only to its own units/scaling/cadence/state/limits. Evaluate a derived relationship only with an approved synchronized formula and tolerance. Do not target the item title, combine unlike types, alter power/load/policy/thresholds, clear logs or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: Every approved POWER member appears exactly once at the correct path with fresh SPEC-valid type-specific value/state and consistent supported-view fields; any approved derived relationship is within tolerance and no power or thermal alarm occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete membership/topology/type mapping and full supported-view evidence meeting approved per-type rules. FAIL on missing/extra/duplicate/stale member, wrong path/type/unit/scaling, mismatch, invalid derived relationship, exceeded approved limit or power fault. Missing map/limits/formula is NOT READY; user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Passive reads only; no PSU/rail/device state, load, power policy, firmware, configuration or threshold change.
Protect credentials and preserve complete power/PSU/thermal/SEL context before filtering.
Stop on unknown semantics, power alarm, identity mismatch, missing/stale record or channel disagreement.
No automatic retry or log clearing; preserve first operating context and discrepancy.
expected_evidence: Versioned POWER membership/type/topology and per-view map
Full timestamped IB/OOB SDR and Sensor-list raw outputs with exits/hashes
Complete Web evidence and per-record type/path/value-or-state/freshness comparison
Aligned workload/policy/redundancy/thermal context and approved derived-formula analysis if applicable
test_case.recovery: On wrong target/path, access failure, unknown type, mismatch, power alarm or thermal fault, stop passive collection and preserve state. Close sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not change power/load/policy, clear logs or retry; escalate exact record and physical path.

source_conflict.reason: Complete discovery plus a signed per-record type/path matrix resolves the broad POWER filter without inventing an aggregate target or equating incompatible quantities.

blocked.reason: Passive collection, semantic separation, evidence, safety and recovery are defined; membership/topology/limits are Project Configuration.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: POWER membership/type list, physical source/load/aggregation topology, units/scaling/cadence/limits, aliases and aligned workload/policy/thermal state.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED TO TYPED PASSIVE POWER POPULATION; NO IPMITOOL, POWER QUERY, AUTHENTICATION, WEB CAPTURE, POWER/LOAD/POLICY/THRESHOLD CHANGE, LOG CLEAR OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
